paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，并据此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看、文件编辑和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最好结果 [abstract]。作者还通过消融实验分析了 ACI 设计选择对 agent 行为和性能的影响 [S1.p4][S5.SS1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计 LM agent 与计算机之间的接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂任务上的表现 [S1.p1]。作者指出，将 agent 应用于软件工程这类更复杂的代码任务仍未被探索，而现有接口是为人类用户设计的 [S1.p1]。作者认为 LM agent 代表一类新的终端用户，有其自身的需求和能力，因此可能从专门设计的接口中受益 [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的系统，其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并配有 guardrails 和简洁反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，agent 每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并接收执行反馈 [S3.p1]。作者假设 LM 固定不变，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent's ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command's effects at every turn.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command's execution in the environment
In this paper, we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance.

We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例，消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 的 300 个实例上进行 [S4.p1]。此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。所有结果基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。对比基线包括非交互式 RAG 基线和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent's basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric, which is the proportion of instances for which all tests pass successfully after the model generated patch is applied to the repository.
Due to budget constraints, we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.

findings.text: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在全部 SWE-bench 测试集上解决 12.47%（286/2,294），在 Lite 上解决 18.00%（54/300），相比 Shell-only 有 64% 的相对提升 [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。消融实验显示，Iterative search 界面在搜索结果多时表现甚至差于无搜索工具（15.7% 降至 12.0%），而缺少文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4]。行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，之后主要是“编辑后执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]。多数失败属于错误实现，约一半（52.0%）未解决实例属于 Incorrect Implementation 或 Overly Specific Implementation [S5.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
An LM-friendly ACI's value is confirmed by SWE-agent's $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
In Table 3, SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
Without SWE-agent's file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue's cause to specific lines of code.
Remaining turns are mostly "edit, then execute" loops.
